# MapQuest

> Official MapQuest maps, driving directions, live traffic, road conditions, local search, and developer location APIs.

MapQuest provides consumer mapping and navigation tools on the web and mobile, along with developer services for routing, geocoding, search, traffic, and static maps. The platform supports trip planning, nearby business discovery, and location-enabled application development.

## Maps, Directions & Traffic
- [MapQuest Home](https://www.mapquest.com/): Main entry point for maps, driving directions, live traffic, and local place discovery.
- [Driving Directions](https://www.mapquest.com/directions): Route planning for point-to-point trips with turn-by-turn directions and travel options.
- [Route Planner](https://www.mapquest.com/routeplanner): Multi-stop trip planning for optimizing routes and organizing several destinations.
- [Traffic](https://www.mapquest.com/traffic): Live traffic map with incidents, congestion, and road condition visibility.
- [Satellite Map](https://www.mapquest.com/satellite): Satellite imagery view for exploring places and geographic context.
- [Hotels](https://www.mapquest.com/us/hotels): Hotel discovery and lodging search integrated with maps and directions.
- [Food](https://www.mapquest.com/us/food): Nearby restaurant and dining search with map-based local results.

## Travel Content
- [Travel](https://www.mapquest.com/travel): Travel inspiration, destination ideas, and road trip editorial content.
- [Route 66 Road Trip Guide](https://www.mapquest.com/travel/route-66-road-trip-guide/): Guide to planning and exploring the classic Route 66 journey.
- [Pan-American Highway Guide](https://www.mapquest.com/travel/pan-american-highway/): Travel feature covering the route, highlights, and planning considerations.
- [Congo River Adventure](https://www.mapquest.com/travel/congo-river/): Destination-focused travel article with exploration and trip context.
- [National Parks](https://www.mapquest.com/travel/national-parks/): Travel content centered on visiting parks and scenic destinations.

## Developer Platform
- [Developer Portal](https://developer.mapquest.com/): Central hub for MapQuest APIs, documentation, keys, and developer resources.
- [Documentation](https://developer.mapquest.com/documentation/): Overview of available APIs, products, and implementation guidance.
- [API Explorer](https://developer.mapquest.com/documentation/tools/route-matrix-api/): Interactive documentation and example requests for selected API endpoints.
- [Plans and Pricing](https://developer.mapquest.com/plans): API usage plans, quotas, and commercial access information.
- [Support](https://developer.mapquest.com/support): Developer help resources, contact options, and troubleshooting information.
- [Terms of Use](https://developer.mapquest.com/terms-of-use): Legal terms governing use of MapQuest developer services.

## Routing & Navigation APIs
- [Directions API](https://developer.mapquest.com/documentation/directions-api/): REST API for turn-by-turn routing, maneuvers, and travel time calculations.
- [Route Matrix API](https://developer.mapquest.com/documentation/route-matrix-api/): API for many-to-many travel time and distance matrix calculations.
- [Traffic API](https://developer.mapquest.com/documentation/traffic-api/): Traffic data services for incidents, flow, and map overlays.
- [Open Directions API](https://developer.mapquest.com/documentation/open/directions-api/): Open routing service based on OpenStreetMap data and MapQuest infrastructure.
- [Open Route Matrix API](https://developer.mapquest.com/documentation/open/route-matrix-api/): Open matrix routing service for travel time and distance computations.

## Geocoding & Search APIs
- [Geocoding API](https://developer.mapquest.com/documentation/geocoding-api/): Convert addresses to coordinates and reverse geocode locations to places.
- [Search API](https://developer.mapquest.com/documentation/search-api/): Search for points of interest, businesses, and places near a location.
- [Open Geocoding API](https://developer.mapquest.com/documentation/open/geocoding-api/): Open geocoding service using OpenStreetMap-based data sources.
- [Place Search Guide](https://developer.mapquest.com/documentation/search-api/v4/): Reference for place search endpoints and query parameters.

## Maps, Imagery & Visualization APIs
- [Static Map API](https://developer.mapquest.com/documentation/static-map-api/): Generate static map images with markers, routes, and custom overlays.
- [Map API](https://developer.mapquest.com/documentation/map-api/): JavaScript mapping library for embedding interactive maps in web applications.
- [Leaflet Plugins](https://developer.mapquest.com/documentation/mapquest-js/): MapQuest JavaScript tools and plugins for Leaflet-based map experiences.
- [Icons API](https://developer.mapquest.com/documentation/icons-api/): Create and customize marker icons for maps and location displays.
- [Elevation API](https://developer.mapquest.com/documentation/elevation-api/): Retrieve elevation profiles and altitude data for routes and coordinates.

## SDKs, Tools & Sample Code
- [Developer Tools](https://developer.mapquest.com/documentation/tools/): Interactive tools for testing requests and exploring API behavior.
- [Geocoding API Explorer](https://developer.mapquest.com/documentation/tools/geocoding-api/): Test geocoding requests and inspect example responses in the browser.
- [Directions API Explorer](https://developer.mapquest.com/documentation/tools/directions-api/): Try routing requests with sample parameters and live output.
- [Static Map API Explorer](https://developer.mapquest.com/documentation/tools/static-map-api/): Build static map image requests and preview generated results.
- [Search API Explorer](https://developer.mapquest.com/documentation/tools/search-api/): Experiment with place search queries and response formats.
